items.quote: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father
items.claim: Isaac re-excavated wells of water that had been dug originally

items.quote: which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father
items.claim: People dug the wells during Abraham's lifetime

items.quote: for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham
items.claim: The Philistines blocked the wells after Abraham's death

items.quote: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them
items.claim: Isaac named the wells using the same names his father Abraham had assigned
items.mechanism: after the names by which his father had called them
